# Genially

> Genially is a no-code platform for creating interactive content experiences across eLearning, business communication, and education with AI-powered features and comprehensive LMS integration.

Genially empowers educators, trainers, and business professionals to build engaging interactive experiences without coding. The platform combines intuitive design tools, AI capabilities, real-time collaboration, and robust analytics to support diverse use cases from K12 classrooms to enterprise training programs.

## Key Topics

- Interactive Content Creation
- LMS Integration (SCORM, LTI)
- AI-Powered Features
- Quiz Builder & Gamification
- Real-time Collaboration
- Brand Kit & Design Tools
- Analytics & Assessment
- Accessibility (WCAG)
- eLearning Authoring
- Live Presentations
- Student Engagement
- Instructional Design
- Animations & Interactions
- Widget Library
- Content Publishing

## Core Features

- [All Features - Explore the product](https://genially.com/features): Complete feature overview covering course authoring, collaboration, and gamification
- [Interactions and Animations](https://genially.com/features/interactions-and-animations): No-code interactions and animations feature for creating interactive content elements
- [AI Features](https://genially.com/features/ai): AI-powered features including text-to-speech, image generation, translation, and quiz generation
- [Quiz Builder](https://genially.com/features/quiz-builder): Interactive quiz builder with AI generation, branching scenarios, and assessment tools
- [Design Tools](https://genially.com/features/design-tools): Visual design tools with drag-and-drop editor, templates, and animation capabilities
- [Widget Library](https://genially.com/features/widget-library): Interactive widget library with gamified activities, timers, and engagement components
- [Analytics & Assessment](https://genially.com/features/analytics-and-assessment): Analytics dashboard with learner tracking, engagement metrics, and assessment reporting

## Collaboration & Publishing

- [Collaboration & Team Management](https://genially.com/features/collaboration-and-team-management): Real-time co-authoring and team collaboration with SSO and admin controls
- [Collaborate with Your Students](https://genially.com/features/collaborate-with-your-students): Student collaboration features for building interactive projects and developing digital skills
- [Sharing & Publishing](https://genially.com/features/sharing-and-publishing): Content distribution via LMS integration, embedding, and social media sharing
- [Present and Play Live](https://genially.com/features/present-and-play-live): Live presentation and interactive quiz hosting with real-time audience engagement
- [Brand Kit](https://genially.com/features/brand-kit): Brand management feature for maintaining visual identity and design consistency

## Learning Management & Integration

- [LMS Integration](https://genially.com/features/lms-integration): SCORM 1.2 and LTI 1.3 compliant integration with learning management systems
- [eLearning Authoring Tool](https://genially.com/solutions/elearning-authoring-tool): eLearning authoring solution for interactive training courses with SCORM compliance

## Industry Solutions

- [Genially for Schools](https://genially.com/solutions/for-schools): K12 education solution for interactive learning materials and classroom engagement
- [Genially for Higher Education](https://genially.com/solutions/higher-education): Higher education solution for interactive lectures, presentations, and course design
- [Genially for Business](https://genially.com/solutions/business): Business-focused solution for interactive decks, infographics, and marketing campaigns

## Accessibility & Compliance

- [Accessibility](https://genially.com/features/accessibility): Accessibility features for WCAG-compliant, inclusive interactive content design
- [Security & Privacy](https://genially.com/trust-center): Security and privacy information including SOC 2, GDPR, and FERPA compliance
